visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Hands roll a piece of dough on a marble surface covered in white sesame seeds next to a white plate. Text overlay introduces the low-sugar, low-oil sesame raisin bread. (2) Three loaves of bread with raisins visible are shown baking inside a brightly lit oven. (3) A close-up shot shows a hand slicing a baked, sesame-covered loaf on a black cutting board, revealing a soft, airy interior. (4) Hands use a white plastic scraper to divide and shape raw dough containing raisins on the marble counter. (5) The hands carefully roll and stretch the dough into a log shape. (6) The log-shaped dough is rolled across a plate of sesame seeds until fully coated. (7) A hand uses a small black scoring knife to make diagonal cuts on top of a large, sesame-covered fermented loaf. (8) Two golden-brown baked loaves sit on a cooling rack by a window, with comparisons to Taiwanese and European styles appearing via text. (9) The final product is displayed on the cooling rack, appearing crusty and fresh.
